name: macp_proposal_counter_proposal
description: CounterProposal: submits a replacement or revised offer. It creates a new proposal and does not retire the one it supersedes; participants may accept either (RFC-MACP-0008 Section 5). Sent as message_type CounterProposal in mode macp.mode.proposal.v1.

proposal_id.description: Identifier of the new counteroffer, unique within the Session.

supersedes_proposal_id.description: The existing proposal this counteroffer is meant to replace.

details.description: Opaque counteroffer details; empty if none. Base64-encoded (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 10.3).
